Bedlam.name: Bedlam
Bedlam.summary: Bedlam is a 1996 run and gun video game developed by Mirage and published by GT Interactive for DOS, Windows, Mac OS, and PlayStation, in which players use a squad of three huge remote assault tanks (RATs) against mutated monsters called Biomex.

Darkstone.name: Darkstone
Darkstone.summary: Darkstone is an action role-playing game with a medieval fantasy setting, played solo or in multiplayer and often compared to Diablo. Players choose from paired character types such as warrior or Amazon, wizard or sorceress, assassin or thief, and monk or priestess, then travel across four increasingly difficult lands to complete quests, fight monsters, and explore dungeons. Gameplay centers on improving character stats and gear, learning spells from spellbooks, and picking up skills like lockpicking and trap disarming, while a central village serves as a hub for trading, banking, and restocking supplies. Randomly selected quests and shifting dungeon layouts vary each playthrough.

Eberouge Special - Koi to Mahou no Gakue.name: Eberouge Special: Koi to Mahou no Gakuen Seikatsu

EOS - Edge of Skyhigh.name: EOS: Edge of Skyhigh
EOS - Edge of Skyhigh.summary: Exhilarating action on the battlefield full of expression and music, full polygon realistic graphics. Use your transformable vehicle and face the EOS using your wide arrange of attacks and strategy.

Floating Runner - Quest for the 7 Crysta.name: Floating Runner: Quest for the 7 Crystals
Floating Runner - Quest for the 7 Crysta.summary:
Floating Runner: Quest for the 7 Crystals is a 3D platform adventure consisting of fourteen levels across seven different themed environments, with classic locales ranging from tropical forests to frozen tundra. As in the Mega Man series of titles, players can choose which of the worlds to attempt in whatever order they so desire.

Populating each world are enemies in the guise of cute animals that can be dispatched using power-ups and weapons found scattered throughout the area. While avoiding the treacherous chasms and gaps that permeate the floating worlds, players will need to seek out special gems while keeping an eye on the time remaining to complete each world. Continues are unlimited so failure is little more than a temporary hindrance.

International Karate +.name: International Karate +
International Karate +.summary:
Call it a sequel... And you'll land up flat on your back.

They called International Karate "the greatest Karate beat' em up yet" (Commodore User). And who are we to argue? But Archer Maclean has come up with a stunner: A third fighter. An amazing animated background. New moves (including double head-kick and a spectacular backflip). Re-mixed music by Rob Hubbard. And Balls!

Kick Off World.name: Kick Off World
Kick Off World.summary: Kick Off World offers the ability to play with national or club teams. The game is not just about playing, coaching is equally important as you head for the Reebok DMX Super League. Kick Off World has four levels, and five modes which includes a practice mode as well as Friendly and Cup Competition modes. As the manager you can sell and buy players.

Koukidou Gensou - Gunparade March.name: Gunparade March
Koukidou Gensou - Gunparade March.summary:
Koukidou Gensou GPM - Gunparade March is a Japanese video game that was later turned into a 3 volume manga and a 12 episode anime.

The video game, Koukidou Gensou Gun Parade March was released on September 28 of 2000, for the PlayStation video game console. It was developed by Alfa System and published by Sony Computer Entertainment. Due to its creativity and attention to detail, it won the prestigious Seiun Award in 2001.

The manga by Hiroyuki Sanadura was serialized in the magazine Dengeki Daioh. The three volumes published by MediaWorks between 2001 and 2003 were translated by ADV Manga between 2004 and 2005.

Looney Tunes Racing.name: Looney Tunes Racing
Looney Tunes Racing.summary: Rev your engines - It's time to burn some Looney Tunes rubber! ACME Corporation, the corporate juggernaut behind such successful products as the Acme Disintegrator Gun and the Acme Portable Hole, is sponsoring a number of racing contests all over the universe for the Looney Tunes characters to compete for the looniest racing champion title.

Marie no Atelier Plus - Salburg no Renki.name: Atelier Marie Plus: The Alchemist of Salburg
Marie no Atelier Plus - Salburg no Renki.summary: Atelier Marie Plus was released on June 4, 1998, and is the last version (Version 1.3) of the original game, with upgrades and additional content added.

Simple Character 2000 Series Vol. 01 - K.name: Simple Characters 2000 Series Vol. 01: Kidou Senshi Gundam - The Gunjin Shougi
Simple Character 2000 Series Vol. 01 - K.summary: Kidou Senshi Gundam - The Gunjin Shougi combines characters from the different Gundam series and the shogi (chess) game.
